definitions.short: Hege or Hegai , a eunuch of Xerxes
definitions.full: H1896. Hege ' הֵגֵא proper name, masculine eunuch of Ahasuerus (probably Persian; compare Ἠγιας , courtier of Xerxes, Ctesias Pers 24 ; also Herodot ix. 33 ; Roed. in Thes Add) Est 2:3 ; = הֵגַי 2:8 , 15 , הֵגָ֑י 2:8 . הגג ( murmur , then muse ; then compare Arabic burn, blaze (of fire), make a murmuring noise in burning; PS gives Syriac phantasma vidit, somniavit ; Ethpe`el & especially Ethpa`al mente concepit, imaginatus est ; compare also הָגָה ). הֵגָ֑י הֵגַי, proper name, masculine see הֵגֵא . הגן (Late Hebrew הֲגַן Aramaic הֲגַן be suitable, fit, worthy: on original meaning compare Fl in NHWB, under the word)
definitions.rootNote: or (by permutation) הֵגַי ; probably of Persian origin;
